name: Scapular Dyskinesis
definition: Altered scapular position or motion that may accompany shoulder pain, instability, nerve injury or kinetic-chain dysfunction.

redFlags.item: Long thoracic or spinal accessory nerve palsy

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; electrodiagnostics or imaging are selected when nerve or structural pathology is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, ligament, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Scapular dyskinesis should be treated as a movement finding rather than assumed to be the sole pain generator.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amsa-gati vikriti may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Altered scapular position or motion that may accompany shoulder pain, instability, nerve injury or kinetic-chain dysfunction.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, airway/vascular symptoms, unreduced dislocation or other listed red flags.
